comment_corrections: Original addressed slot layout and exact ingredient consumption order.
Table slot layout and local ingredient consumption order; native matching stays at the platform boundary.
Same identity as GT6 equalTools: ordinary stacks include NBT; tools retain their own stats.
Ordinary inputs use exact tags; GT tools additionally require matching heads and usable state.
Original AdvancedCraftingTable.png slot coordinates and result-click semantics.
AdvancedCraftingTable.png slot coordinates and server-driven result clicks.

source_guard_examples.case: Real ordinary A in grid and sufficient matching A in an unlocked connected source; permitted recipe, no remainder.
source_guard_examples.original: Connected source consumed first; local specimen retained.
source_guard_examples.current: Only table slots are searched; local A consumed.

source_guard_examples.case: Round-trippable fluid container with a remainder, no matching connected inventory, enough matching unlocked connected-tank fluid.
source_guard_examples.original: Connected tank removes the full refill amount; the filled local container stays.
source_guard_examples.current: Native recipe remainder is put into local slots; there is no adjacent refill lookup.

source_guard_examples.case: Same manual tool kind, both assembled and usable, differing head materials; recipe accepts both.
source_guard_examples.original: equalTools ignores tool NBT; a stored tool can supply the grid specimen.
source_guard_examples.current: same additionally requires equal heads; stored differing-head tool is skipped.

example_limit: Conditional source-contract examples, not executed old/current Java, native crafting, exhaustive recipes or world cases.
preserved_boundaries: Local priority, eight automation slot lists and 63/64 ordering already match source declarations; adjacent access is separate.
Source inventory/tank access is its explicit connected interfaces, not every arbitrary vanilla or modded container.
Current copied-state planning, output-space checks, native remainders with Neo crop offsets, cache invalidation, save protection and per-slot charging paths remain.
Do not strip modern tool material components merely because source blueprints stripped old container-tool NBT; do not re-enable broken tools.
Hand-worktable tool matching is separate from automatic-machine hand-tool rejection and ALIGN-292.
limits: Source analysis and full code/literal/comment/directive preservation only; no new compiler, Gradle, tests, game, jar or push.
Prior dust-funnel compilation does not exercise these worktable features or accept current formatted sources as gameplay-tested.
Full tool/recipe corpus, direct fluid insertion, external energy items, all GUI click modes, charge/hazard behavior, client pixels, datapack lifecycle and saved-world restart remain unverified.

root_revalidation.method: Rehash actual reference/current sources and platform views; compare git baseline snapshots, full ordered Java code, literal positions, comments/directives; recheck selector, connected resource, tool predicate and native consumers. Source guards are not runtime tests.
